crop.visible_input_object: Panel a left-to-center workflow: the 'Multi-Modal Nucleotide Sequences' source box with NCBI RefSeq/GenBank files, genomic DNA & RNA, natural-language annotations, XML tags, and the 'Cross-Modal BPE Tokenizer', feeding via arrow into the 'GenNA Foundation Model' box.
crop.visible_model_interface: The crop includes the model-facing interface where the cross-modal BPE-tokenized inputs enter the GenNA decoder-only transformer in panel a.
crop.rationale: This is the smallest coherent crop that keeps the full source corpus box, the tokenizer step, the connecting arrow, and the immediate GenNA model box. It excludes the downstream 'Emergent Abilities & Generation' outputs and unrelated analysis panels.
